name: Okina Mishio
source:
She is a college student who attends the same university as the main character.
Her atmosphere is innocent, yet she exudes a certain allure, and she is popular with many boys who are attracted to her pheromones.
While attending university, she is also working on her creative writing, aiming to become a novelist, and because of this, she does not know many people around her.

She is seen by others as a slightly mysterious woman.
In fact, her family are well known in the porn industry, and because of this, she has acquired a wealth of sexual knowledge.
She is a lecher who is always having lewd fantasies, which she is ashamed of and hides.
